unlisted_practices: Integrated AI-enabled multimodal emergency care platform (dispatch, IoT devices, point-of-care testing, AI decision support) evaluated with a before-and-after interrupted time series design

screen.reason: The study reports on the real-world deployment and clinical impact evaluation (quasi-experimental before-and-after study) of an AI-enabled multimodal emergency care system across three counties, but it evaluates the overall system implementation rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
